# Frozen v7 migration fixture

These synthetic store bytes were written by Traza v0.24.2 at source commit
`016eab808f7c5c440bd5b85077242810bf7ed758`, before the v8 encoder changes.
They are frozen input, not output generated by the current encoder.

The store contains 24 sealed spans in three v7 segments, rollup sidecars,
one content-addressed `TRZBLOB1` payload, one annotation, a pin named
`fixture-pin`, and one durable unsealed span in `wal.log`. Its current
manifest declares format 7. Opening a copy with v8 must retain all 25 spans,
including `trace-wal`, preserve payload and annotation semantics, migrate
live and pinned segments, and produce an intact generation.

`tests/migration.rs` checks migration, restart, mixed-format resumption,
legacy record-stream completeness, and refusal without replacing damaged
source segments. Always copy this fixture before opening it: the new store
migrates old formats in place. Do not regenerate it with the current encoder.

`SHA256SUMS` records every file under `store/`, including the WAL that has a
narrow exception to the repository's generic log ignore rule.
